title: Mahindi Popcorn and Snack Stand | Walt Disney World Resort
body_text: Mahindi Located in Africa at Disney's Animal Kingdom Theme Park Safari trekking is thirsty work! Visit this roadside hut to satisfy your cravings with a souvenir bucket of popcorn. Then, beat the heat with a beer, water or soda!View Menu African American Snack Dining Plan Meals Not Accepted Operating Hours – 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM Valid admission required. A theme park reservation may be required based on admission type. An Important Message Valid admission required.
